mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (current month value below prior month) predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate for equity cash flows and increase asset attractiveness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS declines from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 230.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where CPIAUCSL > 230.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in retail sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) above their 3-month moving averages predict positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as strong consumer demand supports near-term corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both RSAFS and HOUST exceed 3-month MAs, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 7.0%), a decline in the unemployment rate predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, as labor market improvements boost consumer spending and corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where UNRATE > 7.0% and UNRATE declines from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (current month value above prior month) predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as deteriorating labor conditions reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where UNRATE rises from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts reading below 800 thousand units signals weak consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as housing sector weakness dampens broader economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where HOUST < 800, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) below their respective thresholds predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as dual supply-demand deterioration signals imminent economic contraction.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO < 99.0 and GDPC1 < 13700.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high interest rate regimes (FEDFUNDS > 2.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate predicts positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days, as the market anticipates policy easing to counteract economic slowdown risks.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months where FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS declines from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows remains below 0.03.
